notes: Wall-clock figures are observation times from one poller at options.poll ms, so they are upper bounds: they include the poll gap and the RPC round trip.
Base Sepolia block timestamps are second-granular while blocks are ~200ms, so events in the same second are indistinguishable by timestamp alone.
origin->reaction and reaction->execution cross a chain boundary and so carry the two chains clock offset. Only end-to-end (origin->execution) has both timestamps from the same chain.
